scripts.check: concurrently --group "eslint . --no-cache -f unix" "tsc --noEmit --pretty false" "tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.node.json" "cargo fmt --check" "cargo check --all-targets --features automation && cargo clippy --all-targets --features automation -- -D warnings" "cargo machete" "styling-lint check"
scripts.fix: concurrently -m 1 --group "eslint . --fix --cache" "cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --all-targets --features automation -- -D warnings" "cargo fmt" "styling-lint fix"
scripts.unit: concurrently --group "vitest run unit && node --test tools/release.unit.test.mjs" "cargo test --features probe"
